versions.title: Patch Note #6
changes: Search shows Lil Uzi Vert results instantly, even while the Juice WRLD server is slow or down
Quick search does the same
Searches you've already done open instantly
Nothing sits on Loading... forever: after 12 seconds Abyss tells you the song server didn't answer

versions.title: Patch Note #5
changes: Lil Uzi Vert songs show their album cover: Eternal Atake, Luv Is Rage 1, 1.5, 2 and 3, Pink Tape, Pluto x Baby Pluto and 15 more eras

versions.title: Patch Note #4
changes: Songs start faster: the next song only starts downloading once the current one is playing
A song stuck at 0:00 gets retried automatically, and skipped if it still won't load
The play button pulses while a song is loading

versions.title: Patch Note #3
changes: Lil Uzi Vert: songs marked [V1] and songs under a minute are gone
Lil Uzi Vert songs now show their length
Renaming Lil Uzi Vert songs is @slayer only

versions.title: Patch Note #2
changes: The loading screen no longer gets stuck when the song server is slow or down. Abyss opens anyway and keeps your playlists, local files and Unleaked songs ready
Lil Uzi Vert songs now come up when you search instead of loading as one giant playlist, so it's fast again

versions.title: Patch Note #1 — RELEASE!!!
changes: Welcome to Abyss: every Juice WRLD song, released and unreleased, in one place
Accounts: sign in with email or Google, pick a username and a profile picture (GIFs work)
Your library syncs across PC, Android and iPhone: playlists, likes, history, covers and your own songs
Abyss Connect: see what's playing on your other devices and move the music between them
Synced lyrics with word-by-word full screen, plus write and time your own
Session edits, studio sessions, era covers, community fan covers and your own custom covers
The black hole: a music-reactive planet behind the cover that takes the album's colors
Liquid glass design, Ctrl+K quick search, Your stats, song radio, sleep timer, repeat one
Downloads with the cover built in, and Link to Spotify Local Files
Discord status on PC and Android, lock screen controls and background play on phones
Updates install themselves, no reinstalling
Link to Spotify Local Files can copy EVERYTHING ON ABYSS
Performance mode: one tap (lightning button or P) turns off every effect so Abyss barely uses your PC
Lyrics editor: lines that are already timed stay timed, and Time it only asks you to tap the ones that aren't
Search by lyrics: find any song from a line you remember
